xrefdescription.para: P-RLS-01 — RLS single constraint: user sees only own rows.

detaileddescription.para:
Acceptance:
Policy: user_id = current_principal
Query result is filtered to matching rows only
No row leakage to unprivileged users

xrefdescription.para: P-RLS-02 — RLS cascading constraints: tenant → org → user.

detaileddescription.para:
Acceptance:
Hierarchy: tenant_id = X AND org_id = Y AND user_id = Z
All three constraints must match
If any constraint fails, row is filtered

Acceptance:
Static: region_id = 'US-WEST'
Dynamic: department = current_user.department (from session)
Both must evaluate correctly

xrefdescription.para: P-RLS-04 — RLS with NULL handling in constraint column.

detaileddescription.para:
Acceptance:
Rows with NULL in RLS constraint column are typically denied (conservative)
Or explicitly allowed by policy (if configured)
Default: NULL → DENY

xrefdescription.para: P-MRG-01 — RBAC deny wins over ABAC allow (explicit deny precedence).

detaileddescription.para:
Acceptance:
RBAC rule: "admin" role → DENY "DELETE"
ABAC rule: department="devops" AND level >= 5 → ALLOW "DELETE"
Result: DENY (RBAC takes precedence)

Acceptance:
Two RBAC rules match:
Rule 1: role=user → ALLOW "READ"
Rule 2: role=user AND resource="SENSITIVE" → DENY
Result: most restrictive (DENY) applies

xrefdescription.para: P-MRG-03 — ABAC with conflicting attributes: deterministic precedence.

detaileddescription.para:
Acceptance:
Two ABAC rules conflict:
Rule A: time >= "09:00" → ALLOW
Rule B: time <= "17:00" AND day == "WEEKEND" → DENY
Evaluation at 15:00 on Saturday: DENY (most restrictive)

Acceptance:
Policy has invalid condition/syntax
Cannot be parsed → policy evaluation fails
Access is DENIED (fail-closed, no implicit allow)

xrefdescription.para: P-DENY-01 — No matching rule (empty policy set) → DENIED.

detaileddescription.para:
Acceptance:
Policy cache is empty (no rules)
Any access request → DENIED

xrefdescription.para: P-DENY-02 — Ambiguous rule set: defaults to most restrictive.

detaileddescription.para:
Acceptance:
Two rules with same precedence but conflicting decisions
Evaluation: most restrictive (DENY) applies

Acceptance:
Policy evaluation takes too long (exceeds timeout)
Return DENIED (don't wait or grant implicit allow)
Log timeout event for monitoring

xrefdescription.para: P-DENY-04 — Concurrent policy updates do not allow bypass.

detaileddescription.para:
Acceptance:
Policy is updated (ALLOW → DENY) concurrently
Request in-flight during update sees consistent snapshot
No bypass window where both old and new policies apply

xrefdescription.para: P-MASK-01 — PII fields redacted for non-privileged callers.

detaileddescription.para:
Acceptance:
Result row contains PII fields (email, phone, SSN)
Non-privileged caller: fields are redacted/masked
Privileged caller: fields visible in full

xrefdescription.para: P-MASK-02 — Masking audit trail captures redaction events.

detaileddescription.para:
Acceptance:
Every PII redaction is logged to audit trail
Audit entry includes: principal, resource, fields redacted

xrefdescription.para: Phase 3 Integration: Complex policy with RLS + masking + audit.

detaileddescription.para:
Acceptance:
Query hits RLS constraint (filters rows)
Remaining rows have PII masked for non-privileged caller
All operations audited with timestamps/trace IDs

briefdescription.para: Phase 3 security module policy/data-protection hardening focused tests.

detaileddescription.para: Validates row-level security (RLS), query masking, policy-merge semantics, and deny-by-default behavior under complex policy scenarios.

sect2.title: Test Cases
sect2.para: P-RLS-01 RLS single constraint: user sees only own rows. P-RLS-02 RLS cascading constraints: tenant → org → user hierarchy. P-RLS-03 RLS mixed static/dynamic predicates: column value + session context. P-RLS-04 RLS with NULL handling: rows with NULL in constraint column.

P-MRG-01 RBAC deny wins over ABAC allow (explicit deny precedence). P-MRG-02 Multiple RBAC rules: most-restrictive-match (intersection semantics). P-MRG-03 ABAC with conflicting attributes: policy-merge deterministic precedence. P-MRG-04 Policy misconfiguration (syntax error) → POLICY_MISCONFIGURED fail-closed.

P-DENY-01 No matching rule (empty policy) → access DENIED. P-DENY-02 Ambiguous rule set: defaults to most restrictive interpretation. P-DENY-03 Policy evaluation timeout (exceeded) → DENIED (fail-closed). P-DENY-04 Concurrent policy updates do not allow bypass during transition.
P-MASK-01 PII fields redacted for non-privileged callers. P-MASK-02 Masking audit trail captures redaction events.
